1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
2: Son of man, set your face against Thaeman, and look toward Darom, and prophesy against the chief forest of Nageb,
3: and you shall say to the forest of Nageb, Hear the word of the Lord; thus says the Lord, [even] the Lord; Behold, I [will] kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour in you every green tree, and every dry tree: the flame that is kindled shall not be quenched, and every face shall be scorched with it from the south to the north.
4: And all flesh shall know that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
5: And I said, Not so, O Lord God! they say to me, Is not this that is spoken a parable?
